# MenusQR

> MenusQR lets restaurants, cafes and dhabas in India create a digital QR menu. Dishes, prices and availability can be updated instantly, and the printed table QR code never changes.

## Key pages
- [Digital QR menu](https://menusqr.in/digital-qr-menu): how a digital QR menu works
- [How it works](https://menusqr.in/how-it-works): setup steps
- [Menu templates](https://menusqr.in/templates): ready-made menu designs
- [Plans and pricing](https://menusqr.in/plans): subscription plans
- [FAQ](https://menusqr.in/faq): common questions
- [Contact](https://menusqr.in/contact)
